data.name: Mi Amor, an SLH Hotel
data.address: Carr. Tulum-Boca Paila Km. 4.1, Zona Hotelera Tulum, Zona Costera, 77780 Tulum, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
Set on a rocky cliff amid tropical forest and next to the Caribbean Sea, this boutique hotel is 1 km from Paradise Beach.
Featuring furnished patios or balconies, the refined, minimalist rooms offer wood floors, rain showers and minibars, plus Nespresso machines, stereos and free Wi-Fi (no TVs). Upgraded rooms add private plunge pools, hot tubs and/or sea views. Room service is available.
A la carte breakfast and parking are complimentary. There's a cutting-edge cocktail bar and a bright French/Italian restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows, plus a terrace. Other perks include an infinity pool, beach access and a romantic spa.
